propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been the Principal Data Engineer and design authority for an industrial manufacturer's plant data platform since 2023, spanning the ingestion and serving teams, after a senior data engineer role on the ingestion team from 2019 to 2023.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the principal role and the periods.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate owns the platform's reference architecture implemented by both teams, held the platform's seat on the engineering review board where six architecture proposals were presented under his name, and chaired the technical standards group that issued eleven standards.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the proposals and the board minutes document the architecture ownership, the board seat and the standards group.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate coached the four senior engineers of the two teams under the engineering coaching programme and recorded what each proposal and each standard left open in the required 'not decided here' section.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the coaching and the open-items sections.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the design-authority role, the reference architecture, the board seat, the standards group and the coaching.
expectedBoundaryNote: The principal role and the architecture ownership are documented in the resume, the proposals and the board minutes; the senior engineer years are shown separately.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the architecture repository references of the six proposals to confirm the presenter field.
